# GameplayAbilities

57 tools for the Gameplay Ability System: abilities, attribute sets, gameplay effects and their modifiers, cues, tags and events.

Back to the [index](README.md).

## `activate_ability`

*Destructive.*

Try to activate one granted ability on an editor-world actor ability system component with TryActivateAbility; activated is the engine verdict, false when the activation checks of the ability refuse it. Use grant_ability first, and cancel_ability to stop it.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Object name (not the label) of the editor-world actor, e.g. "BP_Hero_C_1", matched case-insensitively; find_actors_by_name maps labels to names |
| `ability_name` | string | yes | Ability to match among the granted specs: the ability_name from get_active_abilities, the class name with or without _C ("GA_Jump"), the asset path ("/Game/Abilities/GA_Jump") or the class path; case-insensitive, first match wins |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, ability_name, activated }`

## `add_attribute_to_set`

*Additive.*

Add one FGameplayAttributeData member variable to an AttributeSet Blueprint, with default_value as its BaseValue and CurrentValue, then compile and save it. A name that is already an attribute of the class is left as it is (added false, already_existed true, nothing saved); a name taken by a variable of another type fails. attribute_present and base_value are read from the compiled class. An add is refused before any edit when a running PIE session, a read-only root or a .uasset read-only on disk would keep it from being saved, and a failed save undoes it, taking the variable out again and recompiling the Blueprint.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attribute_set_path` | string | yes | Full asset path of the AttributeSet Blueprint |
| `attribute_name` | string | yes | Name of the new attribute member variable |
| `default_value` | number | no | Initial BaseValue and CurrentValue of the attribute, default 0; not applied to an attribute that already exists. |

**Returns:** `{ attribute_set_path: string, attribute_name: string, default_value: number, added: bool, already_existed: bool, attribute_present: bool, base_value?: number, default_applied?: bool, saved: bool }`

## `add_gameplay_effect_component`

*Additive, idempotent.*

Add one empty UGameplayEffectComponent of a standard type to the GEComponents array of a GameplayEffect Blueprint's CDO and save without recompiling. GE components are instanced subobjects of the effect, not actor components, so add_component_to_blueprint and add_component_to_actor cannot add them. Idempotent: an existing component of that type returns already_existed=true. Configure it with the set_gameplay_effect_component_* tools; get_gameplay_effect_components lists them. A running PIE session, a read-only root or a .uasset read-only on disk fails before any edit, and a failed save undoes the edit.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gameplay_effect_path` | string | yes | Asset path of the GameplayEffect Blueprint, e.g. "/Game/GAS/Effects/GE_Damage". |
| `component_type` | string | yes | Bare type name, case-insensitive: AssetTags, TargetTags, AdditionalEffects, ChanceToApply, Immunity, TargetTagRequirements, RemoveOther, CustomCanApply, BlockAbilityTags, Abilities or CancelAbilityTags (not the full class name). |

**Returns:** `{ gameplay_effect_path: string, component_type: string, component_class: string, component_count: int, component_added: bool, already_existed: bool }`

## `add_gameplay_effect_modifier`

*Additive.*

Append one modifier with a constant magnitude to the Modifiers array on the class default object of a GameplayEffect Blueprint, then save it without recompiling and without an undo entry. attribute_name is looked up across every loaded AttributeSet class; an unknown attribute or modifier_op, a running PIE session, a read-only root or a .uasset read-only on disk fails before any edit, and a failed save undoes the edit. Each call appends a new entry, even an identical one; modifier_index says where it went. Change its magnitude type with set_gameplay_effect_modifier_set_by_caller, set_gameplay_effect_modifier_attribute_based or set_gameplay_effect_modifier_custom; remove_gameplay_effect_modifier drops it; get_gameplay_effect_modifiers lists them.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ge_blueprint_path` | string | yes | Full asset path of the GE Blueprint |
| `attribute_name` | string | yes | Attribute to modify, Health or MySet.Health: the bare name or AttributeSetClass.Attribute, case-insensitive, first match among the loaded AttributeSet classes |
| `modifier_op` | string | yes | Add, Multiply, Divide, or Override (case-insensitive) |
| `magnitude` | number | yes | Constant magnitude of the modifier, stored as a ScalableFloat without a curve |

**Returns:** `{ ge_blueprint_path: string, attribute_name: string, modifier_op: string, magnitude: number, modifier_index: int, modifier_count: int, magnitude_readback_ok: bool, magnitude_readback: number, added: bool }`

## `apply_gameplay_effect`

*Destructive.*

Apply a GameplayEffect class to an editor-world actor ability system component: an outgoing spec at the given level, with a fresh context from that component, applied to self. applied tells whether the engine returned a valid handle. apply_multiple_gameplay_effects applies a list.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Object name (not the label) of the editor-world actor, e.g. "BP_Hero_C_1", matched case-insensitively; find_actors_by_name maps labels to names |
| `effect_class` | string | yes | Class path of a UGameplayEffect subclass; a Blueprint GE needs its _C class path, e.g. "/Game/Effects/GE_Burn.GE_Burn_C" |
| `level` | number | no | Effect level for scalable magnitudes, fractions allowed; default 1.0 |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, effect_class, level, applied }`

## `apply_multiple_gameplay_effects`

*Destructive.*

Apply several GameplayEffect classes at one level to an editor-world actor ability system component; each entry is loaded and applied separately, so a bad path does not stop the rest. Returns requested, applied_count, failed_count and the per-entry applied and failed lists.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Object name (not the label) of the editor-world actor, e.g. "BP_Hero_C_1", matched case-insensitively; find_actors_by_name maps labels to names |
| `effect_classes` | array | yes | JSON array of UGameplayEffect class path strings, e.g. ["/Game/Effects/GE_Burn.GE_Burn_C"]; non-string entries go to failed |
| `level` | number | no | GameplayEffect/ability level applied to all effects (default 1.0) |

**Returns:** `{ error, effect_class, applied, active_handle, actor_name, requested, applied_count, failed_count, failed }`

## `cancel_ability`

*Destructive.*

Cancel one granted ability on an editor-world actor ability system component (CancelAbilityHandle), reading its spec before and after: returns was_active, still_active and cancelled. success is false, with an error, when the ability is still active afterwards (it may not allow cancelling).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Object name (not the label) of the editor-world actor, e.g. "BP_Hero_C_1", matched case-insensitively; find_actors_by_name maps labels to names |
| `ability_name` | string | yes | Ability to match among the granted specs: the ability_name from get_active_abilities, the class name with or without _C ("GA_Jump"), the asset path ("/Game/Abilities/GA_Jump") or the class path; case-insensitive, first match wins |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, ability_name, was_active, still_active, cancelled } -- read back from the spec: cancelled means was_active and not still_active`

## `create_attribute_set_blueprint`

*Additive.*

Create a Blueprint parented to UAttributeSet at package_path/name, compile and save it, or reuse the AttributeSet Blueprint already there (created false, already_existed true; a Blueprint of another class there is an error, and is left untouched); with attributes, add one FGameplayAttributeData variable per entry, then compile and save it. A name the class already has is skipped and listed in skipped_attribute_names; success is false when an added attribute is missing from the compiled class or did not get its default_value. A running PIE session, a read-only root or a .uasset read-only on disk fails before anything is created or added; a call that adds nothing to an existing set is not refused and saves nothing (saved false). A failed save makes success false, with saved false and save_error, and the added attributes stay in memory only.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Asset name without a path, e.g. "AS_Character". |
| `package_path` | string | no | Content folder for the new asset, e.g. "/Game/GAS/Attributes"; defaults to /Game/Blueprints. |
| `attributes` | array | no | Optional array of {"name": "Health", "default_value": 100} objects; default_value (default 0) becomes the BaseValue and CurrentValue of the compiled default. Entries without a name are ignored; omitted, the set is created empty (add attributes later with add_attribute_to_set). |

**Returns:** `{ name: string, asset_path: string, parent_class: string, generated_class: string, is_attribute_set: bool, already_existed: bool, attributes_added: int, added_attribute_names: [string], skipped_attribute_names: [string], failed_attribute_names: [string], attributes_applied: bool, created: bool, saved: bool, save_error?: string }`

## `create_gameplay_ability_blueprint`

*Additive.*

Create a Blueprint parented to UGameplayAbility at package_path/name, compile and save it; returns asset_path, generated_class and is_gameplay_ability. A GameplayAbility Blueprint already at that path is returned untouched (created false, already_existed true); a Blueprint of another class there is an error. Refused during PIE.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Asset name without a path, e.g. "GA_Fireball". |
| `package_path` | string | no | Content folder for the new asset, e.g. "/Game/GAS/Abilities"; defaults to /Game/Blueprints. |

**Returns:** `{ name: string, asset_path: string, parent_class: string, generated_class: string, is_gameplay_ability: bool, already_existed: bool, created: bool }`

## `create_gameplay_cue_notify`

*Additive.*

Create a GameplayCueNotify Blueprint of the kind notify_type names -- Static (UGameplayCueNotify_Static, non-instanced one-shot, the default), Burst (UGameplayCueNotify_Burst, modern non-instanced one-shot), Actor (AGameplayCueNotify_Actor, a spawned, instanced cue actor) or Looping (AGameplayCueNotify_Looping, modern instanced looping notify) -- at package_path/name, compile and save it, or reuse the one of that class already there (created false, already_existed true); a Blueprint of another class there, or an unknown notify_type, is an error. A registered gameplay_cue_tag is written to the CDO and saved: a read-only root or a .uasset read-only on disk refuses that write and a failed save undoes it; an unregistered tag only yields cue_tag_set=false. Refused during PIE. Edit it with set_gameplay_cue_notify_static_properties (Static, Burst) or set_gameplay_cue_notify_actor_properties (Actor, Looping).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Asset name without a path, e.g. "GCN_Hit". |
| `package_path` | string | no | Content folder for the new asset, e.g. "/Game/GAS/Cues"; defaults to /Game/Blueprints. |
| `notify_type` | string | no | Optional kind of notify, any case: Static (default), Burst, Actor or Looping. |
| `gameplay_cue_tag` | string | no | Registered gameplay tag written as GameplayCueTag and GameplayCueName, e.g. "GameplayCue.Hit"; an unregistered tag is skipped (cue_tag_set=false), not an error. |

**Returns:** `{ name: string, asset_path: string, parent_class: string, generated_class: string, notify_type: string, is_gameplay_cue_notify: bool, cue_tag_set: bool, cue_tag_requested: string, cue_tag: string, already_existed: bool, created: bool }`

## `create_gameplay_effect_asset`

*Additive.*

Create and save a native UGameplayEffect asset (despite the name, not a container and not a Blueprint) at package_path/name. An existing asset there is returned untouched (already_existed=true). apply_gameplay_effect needs a class, so use create_gameplay_effect_blueprint for an effect it can apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Asset name without a path, e.g. "GE_Damage" |
| `package_path` | string | no | Target content package path where the asset is created (default /Game/GameplayEffects) |
| `duration_policy` | string | no | Duration type, case-insensitive: Instant, HasDuration or Infinite (default Instant) |
| `duration_magnitude` | number | no | Duration in seconds, applied when policy is HasDuration (default 0.0) |

**Returns:** `{ name, asset_path, already_existed, duration_policy, duration_magnitude, created }`

## `get_ability_asset_tags`

*Read-only.*

Read the AssetTags of a GameplayAbility Blueprint from its class default object: ability_tags, asset_tag_count, and ability_name (the default object name). Despite the tool name, no activation data is read: no activation policy, required or blocked tags, cost or cooldown. Read-only and editor-time: it loads the asset and needs no actor or PIE; a path that is not a GameplayAbility Blueprint is an error. set_ability_asset_tags writes these tags; get_ability_info reads an ability granted to an actor.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ability_path` | string | yes | Full /Game path to the ability Blueprint asset |

**Returns:** `{ ability_path: string, ability_name: string, ability_tags: [string], asset_tag_count: int }`

## `get_ability_info`

*Read-only.*

Read one ability granted to an editor-world actor ability system component: ability_class, level, is_active and input_id of the first matching spec. Read-only; an error when no granted spec matches ability_name. Use get_active_abilities to list them all.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Object name (not the label) of the editor-world actor, e.g. "BP_Hero_C_1", matched case-insensitively; find_actors_by_name maps labels to names |
| `ability_name` | string | yes | Ability to match among the granted specs: the ability_name from get_active_abilities, the class name with or without _C ("GA_Jump"), the asset path ("/Game/Abilities/GA_Jump") or the class path; case-insensitive, first match wins |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, ability_name, ability_class, level, is_active, input_id }`

## `get_ability_system_component`

*Read-only.*

Read the ability system component of an editor-world actor (the IAbilitySystemInterface answer, else its first UAbilitySystemComponent): component_name, active_abilities_count (all granted specs, active or not) and active_effects_count. Read-only; a missing actor or component is an error, not has_ability_system=false.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Object name (not the label) of the editor-world actor, e.g. "BP_Hero_C_1", matched case-insensitively; find_actors_by_name maps labels to names |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, has_ability_system, component_name, active_abilities_count, active_effects_count }`

## `get_ability_tasks`

*Read-only.*

List the gameplay tasks the GameplayTasksComponents of an editor-world actor (its ability system component counts) know about, without changing anything: the tasks activated and not yet ended (the component's KnownTasks), plus any queued waiting for task resources. Each has task_name, task_class, task_state (Uninitialized, AwaitingActivation, Active, Paused or Finished), is_ability_task and owner_name (the object that started it, e.g. an ability instance); counts split ability tasks from other gameplay tasks. A task that was created but never activated is not known to the component and is not listed. An actor that is not found, or has no ability system component, is an error.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Object name (not the label) of the editor-world actor, e.g. "BP_Hero_C_1", matched case-insensitively; find_actors_by_name maps labels to names |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, task_count, ability_task_count, generic_task_count, tasks: [{ task_name, task_class, task_state, is_ability_task, owner_name }] }`

## `get_active_abilities`

*Read-only.*

List every ability granted to an editor-world actor ability system component, running or not (all activatable specs, despite the tool name): ability_name (the class default object name), ability_class, level and is_active, plus count. Read-only; get_ability_info reads one.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Object name (not the label) of the editor-world actor, e.g. "BP_Hero_C_1", matched case-insensitively; find_actors_by_name maps labels to names |

**Returns:** `{ ability_name, ability_class, level, is_active, actor_name, abilities, count }`

## `get_active_effects`

*Read-only.*

List the gameplay effects currently active on an editor-world actor ability system component: effect_name (the definition object name), effect_class and level for each, plus count. Read-only; effects whose definition is gone are skipped. get_gameplay_effect_info reads one.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Object name (not the label) of the editor-world actor, e.g. "BP_Hero_C_1", matched case-insensitively; find_actors_by_name maps labels to names |

**Returns:** `{ effect_name, effect_class, level, actor_name, effects, count }`

This reports the AUTHORED defaults on disk, not the live values of any actor -- for those use get_attribute_value / get_attributes.

## `get_attribute_value`

*Read-only.*

Read one attribute from the attribute sets registered on an editor-world actor ability system component: value (current, modifiers included), base_value and attribute_set. Read-only; an unknown attribute is not an error but found=false. get_attributes lists every attribute.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Object name (not the label) of the editor-world actor, e.g. "BP_Hero_C_1", matched case-insensitively; find_actors_by_name maps labels to names |
| `attribute_name` | string | yes | Attribute name ("Health") or "SetClass.Attribute" ("MyAttributeSet.Health"), case-insensitive; the first registered attribute that matches wins |

## `get_attributes`

*Read-only.*

List every attribute of the attribute sets registered on the ability system component of an editor-world actor (its IAbilitySystemInterface answer, else its first UAbilitySystemComponent), each with attribute_name, attribute_set, value (current, modifiers included), base_value and found, plus count. Read-only. A missing actor or component is an error; a component with no registered set gives count 0. Use get_attribute_value for one attribute, set_attribute_base_value to change one.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Object name (not the label) of the editor-world actor, e.g. "BP_Hero_C_1", matched case-insensitively; find_actors_by_name maps labels to names |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name: string, attributes: [{ attribute_name: string, attribute_set?: string, value: number, base_value: number, found: bool }], count: int }`

## `get_gameplay_cue_notify_info`

*Read-only.*

Read the class default object of a GameplayCueNotify Blueprint, loaded by asset path: notify_type (Static, Burst, Actor or Looping), its direct parent_class, GameplayCueTag, GameplayCueName and IsOverride. The lifetime and instancing fields come back only for Actor and Looping notifies; a Static or Burst reply leaves them out. Read-only and editor-time: it writes nothing and needs no PIE or actor. A missing asset or a Blueprint that is not a GameplayCueNotify is an error. Use it to check a notify before or after editing it with set_gameplay_cue_notify_static_properties (Static, Burst) or set_gameplay_cue_notify_actor_properties (Actor, Looping); a new one: create_gameplay_cue_notify.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cue_notify_path` | string | yes | Full asset path of the GameplayCueNotify Blueprint (Static/Burst/Actor/Looping), e.g. "/Game/GAS/Cues/GCN_Hit". |

**Returns:** `{ cue_notify_path: string, parent_class: string, notify_type: string, gameplay_cue_tag: string, gameplay_cue_name: string, is_override: bool, auto_destroy_on_remove?: bool, auto_destroy_delay?: number, auto_attach_to_owner?: bool, unique_instance_per_instigator?: bool, unique_instance_per_source_object?: bool, allow_multiple_on_active_events?: bool, allow_multiple_while_active_events?: bool, num_preallocated_instances?: int }`

## `grant_ability`

*Additive.*

Grant an ability class to an editor-world actor ability system component with GiveAbility at a whole-number level; granted tells whether a valid spec handle came back. Runtime state only (not saved with the level), and granting the same class again adds another spec.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Object name (not the label) of the editor-world actor, e.g. "BP_Hero_C_1", matched case-insensitively; find_actors_by_name maps labels to names |
| `ability_class` | string | yes | Class path of a UGameplayAbility subclass: "/Game/Abilities/GA_Jump.GA_Jump_C" for a Blueprint, "/Script/MyGame.MyAbility" for C++ |
| `level` | number | no | Spec level, a whole number; default 1 |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, ability_class, level, granted }`

## `poll_gameplay_tag_events`

*Read-only.*

Reads fires recorded for a register_gameplay_tag_event subscription since a cursor (non-destructive cursor read, same idiom as poll_delegate_events). Never destructive: call again with next_cursor to keep draining without missing or repeating a fire.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subscription_id` | number | yes | subscription_id returned by register_gameplay_tag_event (required) |
| `cursor` | number | no | Optional; only fires with sequence_id > cursor are returned. Defaults to 0 (everything retained). |

**Returns:** `{ subscription_id: number, subscription_exists: bool, events: [{sequence_id: number, timestamp: number, new_count: number}], next_cursor: number }`

## `register_gameplay_tag_event`

*Additive, idempotent.*

Registers a REAL listener on a target actor's UAbilitySystemComponent for a gameplay tag's count changes (UAbilitySystemComponent::RegisterGameplayTagEvent, AbilitySystemComponent.h), binding an actual callback (.AddLambda) and keeping its FDelegateHandle so unregister_gameplay_tag_event can honestly undo it later. Idempotent: re-registering the same (actor, tag, event_type) returns the existing subscription_id instead of stacking a duplicate listener. Poll fires with poll_gameplay_tag_events.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Display label or internal name of the target editor-world actor (required) |
| `event_tag` | string | yes | FGameplayTag name (e.g. "Gameplay.Event.Hit") (required) |
| `event_type` | string | no | "NewOrRemoved" \| "AnyCountChange" (default "NewOrRemoved") |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name: string, event_tag: string, event_type: string, subscription_id: number, registered: bool, already_existed: bool }`

## `remove_ability`

*Destructive.*

Remove one granted ability from an editor-world actor ability system component with ClearAbility. An active ability is only marked, and leaves when it ends (pending_removal=true); removed=true means the spec is gone. success is false with an error otherwise.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Object name (not the label) of the editor-world actor, e.g. "BP_Hero_C_1", matched case-insensitively; find_actors_by_name maps labels to names |
| `ability_name` | string | yes | Ability to match among the granted specs: the ability_name from get_active_abilities, the class name with or without _C ("GA_Jump"), the asset path ("/Game/Abilities/GA_Jump") or the class path; case-insensitive, first match wins |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, ability_name, removed, pending_removal } -- read back: removed means the spec is gone; an active ability is only marked, and leaves when it ends (pending_removal)`

## `remove_gameplay_effect`

*Destructive.*

Remove the first active gameplay effect on an editor-world actor ability system component whose definition matches effect_name, with all its stacks (RemoveActiveGameplayEffect). removed is the engine answer confirmed by the effect no longer being active; success is false with an error otherwise.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Object name (not the label) of the editor-world actor, e.g. "BP_Hero_C_1", matched case-insensitively; find_actors_by_name maps labels to names |
| `effect_name` | string | yes | Active effect to match by its definition: the effect_name from get_active_effects, the class name with or without _C ("GE_Burn"), the asset path ("/Game/Effects/GE_Burn") or the class path; case-insensitive, first match wins |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, effect_name, removed } -- removed is what the engine reports, confirmed by the effect not being active afterwards`

## `remove_gameplay_effect_component`

*Destructive.*

Remove a component from a GameplayEffect CDO's GEComponents array by index or by component_type/component_class (inverse of add_gameplay_effect_component), and save; the removed component is left out of the saved asset. A running PIE session, a read-only root or a .uasset read-only on disk fails before any edit, and a failed save undoes the edit.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gameplay_effect_path` | string | yes | Full asset path of the GE Blueprint |
| `component_index` | number | no | Optional index into the GEComponents array (call get_gameplay_effect_components to enumerate; 0 = first). Supply this OR component_type |
| `component_type` | string | no | Optional friendly type (AssetTags, TargetTags, AdditionalEffects, ChanceToApply, Immunity, TargetTagRequirements, RemoveOther, CustomCanApply, BlockAbilityTags, Abilities, CancelAbilityTags). Accepts the bare type or the full class name. Supply this OR component_index |
| `component_class` | string | no | Alias of component_type (accepts the full "&lt;Type>GameplayEffectComponent" class name) |

**Returns:** `{ gameplay_effect_path: string, removed_index: int, removed_class: string, component_count: int, removed: bool, saved: bool }`

## `set_ability_asset_tags`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Replace the asset tags on the class default object of a GameplayAbility Blueprint, loaded by asset path, with the registered tags in asset_tags, then save the asset without recompiling. The list is the whole new set: tags already there and not listed are dropped, an empty list clears them all, and a string that is not a registered tag is skipped and listed in unknown_tags instead of failing the call. Every call writes and saves, even when the tags are unchanged. A path that is not a GameplayAbility Blueprint, a running PIE session, a read-only root or a .uasset read-only on disk fails before any edit, and a failed save undoes the edit. Read back: get_ability_asset_tags; register a tag first: create_gameplay_tag; tags a GameplayEffect owns: set_gameplay_effect_component_asset_tags.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ability_blueprint_path` | string | yes | Asset path of the GameplayAbility Blueprint, e.g. "/Game/GAS/Abilities/GA_Fireball". |
| `asset_tags` | array | yes | Array of gameplay tag strings that becomes the whole asset-tag set, e.g. ["Ability.Fire", "Ability.Type.Magic"]; an empty array clears every asset tag. |

**Returns:** `{ ability_blueprint_path: string, resolved_tags: [string], unknown_tags: [string], ability_tags: [string], tag_count: int, configured: bool }`

## `set_ability_cooldown`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Point CooldownGameplayEffectClass on the class default object of a GameplayAbility Blueprint at the generated class of a GameplayEffect Blueprint, both loaded by asset path, then save the ability without recompiling. That effect is applied when the ability commits and the tags it grants block re-activation while it lasts, so give it a duration with set_gameplay_effect_duration and a cooldown tag with set_gameplay_effect_component_target_tags. Any cooldown class already set is overwritten, and every call writes and saves, even with the same class; there is no way to clear it here. A path that is not a GameplayAbility or GameplayEffect Blueprint, a running PIE session, a read-only root or a .uasset read-only on disk fails before any edit, and a failed save undoes the edit. The cost effect: set_ability_cost; a new effect: create_gameplay_effect_blueprint.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ability_blueprint_path` | string | yes | Asset path of the GameplayAbility Blueprint, e.g. "/Game/GAS/Abilities/GA_Fireball". |
| `cooldown_effect_path` | string | no | Asset path of the GameplayEffect Blueprint used as the cooldown, e.g. "/Game/GAS/Effects/GE_Cooldown_Fireball"; typically a HasDuration effect. |

**Returns:** `{ ability_blueprint_path: string, cooldown_effect_path: string, cooldown_effect_class: string, cooldown_effect_class_matches: bool, set: bool }`

## `set_attribute_meta_on_set_class`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

WHAT IT DOES NOT DO: it never writes the CDO -- only the DataTable is authored, and the running game is still expected to call CDO->InitFromMetaDataTable(DataTable) itself at character init (typically from an ASC's InitStats path). ## `set_gameplay_cue_notify_actor_properties`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Write the GameplayCueTag (mirrored into GameplayCueName) and the lifetime, instancing and override properties you pass on the class default object of an AGameplayCueNotify_Actor Blueprint (Looping ones included), then save it without recompiling and without an undo entry. Prefer it to set_properties on the CDO: the tag is checked against the registry, GameplayCueName stays in sync, and the edit is saved, or undone if the save fails. Properties left out keep their values; every call writes and saves even when nothing differs. Passing none, an unregistered tag, or a Blueprint of another class is an error and nothing is written. Looping and application effects (particles, sounds) are not authored. A running PIE session, a read-only root or a read-only .uasset fails before any edit. Static or Burst notifies: set_gameplay_cue_notify_static_properties; read back: get_gameplay_cue_notify_info.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cue_notify_path` | string | yes | Full asset path of the GameplayCueNotify_Actor/_Looping Blueprint |
| `gameplay_cue_tag` | string | no | Optional registered GameplayCue tag (sets GameplayCueTag + mirrors GameplayCueName); unregistered -> clean error |
| `auto_destroy_on_remove` | boolean | no | Optional bool: auto recycle/destroy when OnRemove fires |
| `auto_destroy_delay` | number | no | Optional float: seconds to stay alive before auto-destroy (needs auto_destroy_on_remove) |
| `auto_attach_to_owner` | boolean | no | Optional bool: attach the cue actor to the target while active |
| `is_override` | boolean | no | Optional bool: this cue overrides parent-tag cues instead of running in addition |
| `unique_instance_per_instigator` | boolean | no | Optional bool: a new instance per instigator |
| `unique_instance_per_source_object` | boolean | no | Optional bool: a new instance per source object |
| `allow_multiple_on_active_events` | boolean | no | Optional bool: re-trigger On Burst if already triggered |
| `allow_multiple_while_active_events` | boolean | no | Optional bool: re-trigger On Become Relevant if already triggered |
| `num_preallocated_instances` | number | no | Optional int: how many instances of the cue to preallocate |

**Returns:** `{ cue_notify_path: string, properties_set: int, gameplay_cue_tag: string, gameplay_cue_name: string, auto_destroy_on_remove: bool, auto_destroy_delay: number, auto_attach_to_owner: bool, is_override: bool, unique_instance_per_instigator: bool, unique_instance_per_source_object: bool, allow_multiple_on_active_events: bool, allow_multiple_while_active_events: bool, num_preallocated_instances: int, note?: string (Looping notifies), set: bool }`

## `set_gameplay_cue_notify_static_properties`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set GameplayCueTag (mirrored into GameplayCueName) and/or IsOverride on the CDO of a UGameplayCueNotify_Static Blueprint (UGameplayCueNotify_Burst ones included), then save it without recompiling. | `gameplay_cue_tag` | string | no | Optional registered GameplayCue tag (sets GameplayCueTag + mirrors GameplayCueName); unregistered -> clean error |

**Returns:** `{ cue_notify_path: string, properties_set: int, gameplay_cue_tag: string, gameplay_cue_name: string, is_override: bool, note?: string (Burst notifies), set: bool }`

## `set_gameplay_effect_component_asset_tags`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set the gameplay tags a GameplayEffect asset owns (they describe the GE and are not given to its target): the Added tags of the AssetTagsGameplayEffectComponent on the class default object of a GE Blueprint loaded by asset path, adding the component when missing (already_existed says which), then save without recompiling. tags becomes the whole Added list and the Removed list is emptied (tags inherited from a parent GE remain); unregistered strings are skipped into unknown_tags and the call still succeeds, with asset_tags read back. | `tags` | array | yes | List of gameplay tag strings the GE asset owns (replaces the component's Added tags) |

**Returns:** `{ ge_blueprint_path: string, component_class: string, resolved_tags: [string], unknown_tags: [string], asset_tags: [string], tag_count: int, already_existed: bool, set: bool }`

## `set_gameplay_effect_modifier_attribute_based`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Replace the magnitude of the modifier at modifier_index on the class default object of a GameplayEffect Blueprint with an AttributeBased one: backing_attribute, captured from attribute_source, scaled as (value + pre_multiply_add) * coefficient + post_multiply_add, under one of the four calculation policies (with AttributeMagnitudeEvaluatedUpToChannel, only through mod channel final_channel), then save the asset without recompiling. The modifier keeps its attribute and operation, but its previous magnitude is discarded whole, attribute curve and tag filters included. The policy and channel are read back. An unknown attribute, a bad attribute_source, calculation_type or final_channel, an out-of-range modifier_index, a running PIE session, a read-only root or a .uasset read-only on disk fails before any edit, and a failed save undoes the edit. Refine afterwards with set_gameplay_effect_modifier_attribute_curve or set_gameplay_effect_modifier_attribute_tag_filters.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ge_blueprint_path` | string | yes | Full asset path of the GE Blueprint |
| `modifier_index` | number | yes | Index into the GE CDO Modifiers array (0 = first) |
| `backing_attribute` | string | yes | Attribute to capture, e.g. Health or MySet.Health (must exist on some AttributeSet) |
| `attribute_source` | string | no | Capture source: Source (caster) or Target (recipient). Default Source |
| `coefficient` | number | no | Multiplier applied to the captured value. Default 1.0 |
| `pre_multiply_add` | number | no | Additive value applied before the coefficient. Default 0.0 |
| `post_multiply_add` | number | no | Additive value applied after the coefficient. Default 0.0 |
| `calculation_type` | string | no | AttributeMagnitude \| AttributeBaseValue \| AttributeBonusMagnitude \| AttributeMagnitudeEvaluatedUpToChannel (any case). Default AttributeMagnitude |
| `final_channel` | number | no | Optional mod evaluation channel (0-9) at which AttributeMagnitudeEvaluatedUpToChannel stops evaluating the attribute. Default 0; only with that calculation_type, an error with another |
| `snapshot` | boolean | no | If true capture the attribute at spec creation, else track changes. Default true |

**Returns:** `{ ge_blueprint_path: string, modifier_index: int, modifier_count: int, magnitude_type: string, backing_attribute: string, capture_attribute_readback: string, backing_attribute_matches: bool, attribute_source: string, coefficient: number, pre_multiply_add: number, post_multiply_add: number, calculation_type: string (read back; Unknown when unreadable), final_channel?: int, final_channel_readback?: int, channel_matches?: bool (the three only with AttributeMagnitudeEvaluatedUpToChannel), snapshot: bool, set: bool }`

## `set_gameplay_effect_modifier_custom`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Replace the magnitude of the modifier at modifier_index on the class default object of a GameplayEffect Blueprint with a CustomCalculationClass one: calculation_class computes the base value, scaled as (value + pre_multiply_add) * coefficient + post_multiply_add, and the asset is saved without recompiling. The modifier keeps its attribute and operation, but its previous magnitude is discarded whole (a FinalLookupCurve included), and omitted coefficients take their defaults, not the old values. An unknown, abstract or non-UGameplayModMagnitudeCalculation class, an out-of-range modifier_index, a running PIE session, a read-only root or a .uasset read-only on disk fails before any edit, and a failed save undoes the edit. Make the class with create_gameplay_mod_magnitude_calculation_blueprint, add a lookup curve with set_gameplay_effect_modifier_custom_curve; other magnitudes: set_gameplay_effect_modifier_attribute_based, set_gameplay_effect_modifier_set_by_caller.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ge_blueprint_path` | string | yes | Full asset path of the GE Blueprint |
| `modifier_index` | number | yes | Index into the GE CDO Modifiers array (0 = first) |
| `calculation_class` | string | yes | BP asset path (/Game/...) or class name of a CONCRETE UGameplayModMagnitudeCalculation subclass |
| `coefficient` | number | no | Multiplier applied to the calc output. Default 1.0 |
| `pre_multiply_add` | number | no | Additive value applied before the coefficient. Default 0.0 |
| `post_multiply_add` | number | no | Additive value applied after the coefficient. Default 0.0 |

**Returns:** `{ ge_blueprint_path: string, modifier_index: int, modifier_count: int, magnitude_type: string, calculation_class: string, calculation_class_matches: bool, coefficient: number, pre_multiply_add: number, post_multiply_add: number, set: bool }`

## `set_gameplay_effect_modifier_custom_curve`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set the FinalLookupCurve (a CurveTable row) on a GE modifier whose magnitude is already CustomCalculationClass; the custom calc output is remapped through the curve. A running PIE session, a read-only root or a .uasset read-only on disk fails before any edit, and a failed save undoes the edit.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ge_blueprint_path` | string | yes | Full asset path of the GE Blueprint |
| `modifier_index` | number | yes | Index into the GE CDO Modifiers array; the modifier's magnitude must already be CustomCalculationClass (call set_gameplay_effect_modifier_custom first) |
| `curve_table_path` | string | yes | Full asset path of the UCurveTable holding the lookup row |
| `row_name` | string | yes | Name of the row within the CurveTable to use as the final lookup curve |

**Returns:** `{ ge_blueprint_path: string, modifier_index: int, modifier_count: int, magnitude_type: string, calculation_class: string, curve_table_path: string, curve_table_readback: string, curve_table_matches: bool, row_name: string, row_name_readback: string, row_name_matches: bool, row_exists: bool, set: bool }`

## `set_gameplay_effect_modifier_set_by_caller`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Switch an existing GE modifier's magnitude to SetByCaller (resolved at runtime by tag/name). A running PIE session, a read-only root or a .uasset read-only on disk fails before any edit, and a failed save undoes the edit.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ge_blueprint_path` | string | yes | Full asset path of the GE Blueprint |
| `modifier_index` | number | yes | Index into the GE CDO Modifiers array (add_gameplay_effect_modifier appends; 0 = first) |
| `data_tag` | string | no | Optional gameplay tag the caller uses to set the magnitude (modern path; must be a registered tag) |
| `data_name` | string | no | Optional legacy FName the caller uses to set the magnitude. At least one of data_tag/data_name is required |

**Returns:** `{ ge_blueprint_path: string, modifier_index: int, modifier_count: int, magnitude_type: string, data_tag: string, data_tag_valid: bool, data_name: string, set: bool }`

## `set_gameplay_effect_period`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set Period (seconds between periodic executions, 0 = not periodic) and bExecutePeriodicEffectOnApplication on the class default object of a GameplayEffect Blueprint, then save it without recompiling and without an undo entry. execute_on_application is always written, so leaving it out sets false. A non-GE Blueprint, a running PIE session, a read-only root or a .uasset read-only on disk fails before any edit, and a failed save undoes the edit. For damage or heal over time also give the effect a duration with set_gameplay_effect_duration; stacking is set_gameplay_effect_stacking.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ge_blueprint_path` | string | yes | Full asset path of the GE Blueprint. |
| `period_seconds` | number | yes | Period in seconds between executions (0 = non-periodic). |
| `execute_on_application` | boolean | no | Optional: if true the effect also executes immediately on application (default false). |

**Returns:** `{ ge_blueprint_path, period_seconds, period_readback_ok, execute_on_application, set }`

## `set_gameplay_effect_stacking`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Write the stacking policy on the class default object of a GameplayEffect Blueprint, loaded by asset path: StackingType always, and StackLimitCount, StackDurationRefreshPolicy and StackPeriodResetPolicy only when given (omitted ones keep their values), then save it without recompiling. Policy strings match case-insensitively. Every call writes and saves, even with the same values; stacking_type, stack_limit and stacking_matches are read back. An unknown stacking_type or policy, a non-GE Blueprint, a running PIE session, a read-only root or a .uasset read-only on disk fails before any edit, and a failed save undoes the edit. Stacking only matters for effects that last: give it a duration with set_gameplay_effect_duration and a tick with set_gameplay_effect_period; the modifiers are add_gameplay_effect_modifier.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ge_blueprint_path` | string | yes | Full asset path of the GE Blueprint. |
| `stacking_type` | string | yes | None \| AggregateBySource \| AggregateByTarget. |
| `stack_limit` | number | no | Optional max stack count (int; 0 = no limit). |
| `duration_refresh_policy` | string | no | Optional: RefreshOnSuccessfulApplication \| NeverRefresh. |
| `period_reset_policy` | string | no | Optional: ResetOnSuccessfulApplication \| NeverReset. |

**Returns:** `{ ge_blueprint_path, stacking_type, stack_limit, stacking_matches, set }`

## `unregister_gameplay_tag_event`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Honestly unbinds a register_gameplay_tag_event subscription (UAbilitySystemComponent::UnregisterGameplayTagEvent, AbilitySystemComponent.h) using the real FDelegateHandle captured at register time, and removes it from the registry. Idempotent: an unknown/already-removed subscription_id is a success with removed:false, not an error.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subscription_id` | number | yes | subscription_id returned by register_gameplay_tag_event (required) |

**Returns:** `{ subscription_id: number, removed: bool, was_registered: bool, engine_unregister_ok: bool }`
